guide.headline: PhD in Italy (Dottorato di Ricerca) — A to Z
guide.intro: Italian PhD admissions are competitive public selections (concorso) run by each university. Many use the national PICA platform (pica.cineca.it); others use Esse3 or their own portals (PoliMi, PoliTo, Bologna, Sapienza Infostud, etc.). Cycle XLII = A.Y. 2026/2027.

procedure.title: Understand the Italian PhD model
procedure.body: A Dottorato lasts usually 3 years (sometimes 4). You apply to a specific PhD course/school, not a free-form supervisor-only track (though supervisors matter). Most funded seats include a scholarship (borsa di dottorato).

procedure.title: Check the cycle and bando
procedure.body: Each year MUR cycle numbers advance (XLII = 2026/27). Read the university Call (bando) + programme annex: seats, scholarships, topics, documents, interview dates, and whether English is allowed.

procedure.title: Confirm the portal type
procedure.body: PICA: register at pica.cineca.it (or use SPID) then open that university’s competition link. Esse3: university student portal. Own: PoliMi Online Services, Apply@PoliTo, Studenti Online (Bologna/Florence), Infostud/Delphi, etc. Never email applications unless the call explicitly allows it.

procedure.title: Degree requirement
procedure.body: You need a second-cycle degree (Laurea Magistrale / MSc or equivalent EQF-7) by the date in the call (often 31 Oct of the start year; visa applicants may have earlier dates). Foreign degrees may need CIMEA comparability/verification or DOV later for enrolment/visa.

procedure.title: Prepare the file
procedure.body: Typical pack: passport/ID, CV, degree + transcripts (IT/EN), abstract of thesis, research proposal (progetto di ricerca), motivation letter, publications if any, English certificate if required, reference letters if asked, PagoPA fee receipt (€20–€50 typical).

procedure.title: Write a focused research proposal
procedure.body: Match the PhD curriculum themes or a predefined topic (tema vincolato). State problem, methods, data, timeline, and fit with the school. Many boards score the project heavily before interview.

procedure.title: Submit online before the deadline
procedure.body: Upload PDFs only, respect size limits, print-sign-scan where required. You can save drafts on PICA. Deadlines are usually Italian time and strict.

procedure.title: Selection: titles + interview
procedure.body: Common pattern: evaluation of CV/qualifications ± project, then oral interview (often remote for candidates abroad). English is frequently assessed at interview even when the formal language is Italian.

procedure.title: Ranking, scholarship, enrolment
procedure.body: Rankings list winners with/without scholarship. Accept and enrol on the portal by the deadline. Scholarship is roughly €16,200–€17,600 gross/year (MUR rules; exact amount in the call), with possible increase for approved research periods abroad.

procedure.title: Visa for non-EU winners
procedure.body: After admission, complete Universitaly pre-enrolment if required, prepare CIMEA/DOV as instructed, then study visa via Embassy Islamabad or BLS Karachi (Sindh/Balochistan). PhD is a full-time research commitment.

documentsChecklist: Master’s degree certificate or expected graduation statement
Research project (if required by the annex)
English proof (IELTS/TOEFL/MOI) when the call asks — many assess English only at interview
Reference letters (if the portal requests them)
picaSteps: Open https://pica.cineca.it/en/login and register (or use SPID / LOGINMIUR if you have it).
From the university PhD page, open the exact competition URL (example patterns: /unipd/dottorati42, /unicam/phd42, /unibg/dottorato42).
Select the PhD course and curriculum/topic preferences.
Fill education data and upload mandatory PDFs.
Pay the fee if required, review, and submit — keep the receipt/protocol number.
Watch email + university albo for interview calendar and ranking.
guide.englishReality: Fully English-taught PhD ‘degrees’ are less common than English-friendly STEM/social-science programmes where coursework, research, thesis, and interviews can run in English. Always read the programme sheet language line.
guide.scholarshipNote: National baseline scholarship is set by MUR decree (often cited around €16,243–€17,600 gross/year depending on year/call). Budget for living costs until the first payment; some unis pay after enrolment/arrival.
guide.universitalyNote: Non-EU students usually need Universitaly pre-enrolment and a study visa after winning a seat. Confirm with the PhD office — procedures differ slightly from bachelor/master tracks.
